summary: Architectural plan and specifications for the Smart Food Redistribution Platform (24-hour hackathon prototype). Delivers: (1) full TypeScript data models for Provider, NGO, Food Donation, and Collection, (2) structured page views for Provider, NGO, and Dispatcher/Simulator with persona switcher, (3) clear donation status lifecycle state machine, and (4) plain-step hybrid greedy batching algorithm respecting vehicle capacity, shortest route, and food-safety deadlines.
